queue_empty: The music queue is currently empty.
joined_desc: Connected to **{channel}**. Use /play to start music, or /music for playback controls.
stopped_desc: Playback stopped and the queue was cleared.
confirm_stop_desc: There are **{count}** tracks in the queue. Run **/music stop** again within 15 seconds to confirm.
mode_247_enabled: 24/7 mode enabled. The bot will stay in the voice channel when the queue ends.
mode_247_disabled: 24/7 mode disabled. The bot will leave after 30 seconds of idle time.
err_lavalink_unavailable: Music is temporarily unavailable — no Lavalink nodes are connected. Try again shortly or configure your own Lavalink server.
err_channel_unavailable: Could not access that voice channel.
err_missing_permissions: I need **Connect** and **Speak** permissions in your voice channel.
err_connection_failed: Could not connect to the voice channel. Ensure Lavalink is online, the bot has Connect and Speak permissions, then try again.
err_riffy_unavailable: Music is unavailable — Lavalink is not configured.
err_not_in_voice: You need to be in a voice channel.
err_wrong_voice: You must be in the same voice channel as the bot to control music.
err_youtube_blocked: YouTube links are not supported. Try a song name instead.
err_no_results: No results found for that query.
err_duplicate_track: **{title}** is already in the queue or playing.
err_no_player: No active music player. Use `/play` first.
err_not_seekable: This track cannot be seeked (it may be a live stream).
err_seek_out_of_range: You can only seek up to {seconds}s for this track.
err_invalid_index: Invalid queue position. Queue has {count} track(s).
err_not_in_vc: I am not in a voice channel.
